title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

  

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled **Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer** to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:
  + Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
  + Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
  + Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Solution Development:
  + Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
  + Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
  + Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
  + Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
  + Integration and Deployment:
* API Development:
  + Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
  + Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
  + Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
  + Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.
* Data Strategy and Preparation:
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
  + Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.
* Innovation and Research:
  + Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
  + Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
  + Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
  + Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidate Privacy Policy

Orion Systems Integrators, LLC and its subsidiaries and its affiliates (collectively, "Orion," "we" or "us") are committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) ("Notice") explains:

* What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;
* How we handle that information; and
* How to access and update that information.

Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

title: Technical Support Lead- Infrastructure & Cloud
description:
Overview:  
Here's a more polished, professional, and attractive version of the job description:

IT Support Lead - Cloud & InfrastructureAbout the Role

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled **IT Support Lead** to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced IT professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional customer support, leading high-performing teams, and managing both cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.

As the IT Support Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing technical support operations, resolving complex issues, guiding support engineers, and driving cloud adoption strategies for our clients. The ideal candidate combines strong leadership capabilities with deep technical expertise across modern cloud platforms and traditional IT infrastructure.

Key ResponsibilitiesLeadership & Service Delivery

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of IT support engineers to ensure outstanding customer service and technical excellence.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business disruption.
* Establish and maintain support processes, service standards, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.
* Conduct regular team training sessions and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance technical capabilities.

Client Engagement & Consulting

* Build strong relationships with clients by understanding their business and technology requirements.
* Provide strategic IT recommendations and serve as a trusted advisor for infrastructure and cloud solutions.
* Deliver exceptional customer experience through proactive communication and issue management.

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

* Design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable, and high-performing cloud environments across:
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Monitor cloud resources to optimize performance, cost efficiency, reliability, and security.
* Support hybrid IT environments integrating on-premises infrastructure with cloud-based services.
* Manage server, network, storage, virtualization, and endpoint technologies.

Technical Support & Operations

* Troubleshoot and resolve advanced infrastructure, networking, system, and application issues.
* Provide ongoing maintenance, upgrades, and support for business-critical applications and services.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge-base articles.
* Ensure compliance with security standards, backup policies, and disaster recovery procedures.

Projects & Business Growth

* Participate in IT transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and system deployments.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to identify opportunities for managed services and cloud solutions.
* Assist in technical pre-sales discussions, solution design, and client presentations.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum **2+ years of experience in IT Support**, with at least **1+ year in a leadership, team lead, or supervisory role**.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Solid understanding of cloud service models including **IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS**.
* Experience managing Windows and Linux server environments.
* Knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, and security best practices.
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as **VMware, Hyper-V**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Google Cloud Certified - Professional Cloud Architect
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Microsoft 365 Administration experience
* Experience with cybersecurity and compliance frameworks
* Knowledge of automation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)

What We Offer

✅ Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies  
✅ Leadership role with career growth potential  
✅ Exposure to diverse IT environments and enterprise clients  
✅ Collaborative and innovative work culture  
✅ Continuous learning, certification, and professional development support

Join Us

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex challenges, and have the leadership skills to drive exceptional IT support services, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help organizations transform their IT operations through innovative cloud and infrastructure solutions.

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹360,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Experience:

* Technical support: 1 year (Required)
* total work: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

Pay: ₹729,000.00 - ₹1,130,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: SalesForce Development Lead
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

Specializes in planning, designing, and developing software systems (e.g., middleware, legacy, mainframe) and applications from concept phase to series production used in local, networked, cloudbased or internet related computer programs. Developers design, code, test, debug, and document program requirements, working with architects, product managers, and endusers in the development and enhancement of applications. Plans, designs, and develops software systems from concept phase to production in local networks or cloud based related computer programs. Codes in relevant languages. LEAD: Recognized subject matter expert in sub-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience. Responsibilities typically include:

* Managing large projects or processes and/or products and systems with limited oversight from management.
* Coaching, reviewing and delegating work to lower-level professionals.
* Facing IT function related problems that are difficult and moderately complex.
* Serving as an expert within own discipline

  
  
**About you**

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Development

* Design, develop and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components and Salesforce Flows.
* Build scalable and maintainable functionality aligned with business requirements.

Solution Delivery

* Work with business analysts and stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
* Participate in technical design activities and solution reviews.
* Estimate effort, identify risks and contribute to delivery planning.
* Support testing and deployment activities throughout the development lifecycle.

Integration Development

* Work with the Integration team to design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems.
* Support integration requirements relating to key broking systems and toolsets.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and implement long-term improvements.
* Ensure integrations meet operational, security and performance requirements.

Production Support

* Investigate and resolve production issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities.
* Support warranty, enhancement and maintenance activities.
* Assist with release management and deployment processes.

Development Standards and Governance

* Follow established coding standards and development practices.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation.
* Participate in peer reviews and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Salesforce practice.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities and identify opportunities for adoption.
* Support the introduction of AI-enabled Salesforce functionality where appropriate.
* Recommend improvements to platform architecture, processes and delivery practices.
* Contribute to the long-term evolution of the Salesforce platform.

Skills and Experience

Required

* Minimum 7 years' Salesforce development experience.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Salesforce architecture.
* Experience developing integrations using APIs and middleware platforms.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security and data models.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

description:

Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

JIRA Cloud Engineer

Overview

The JIRA Cloud Engineer is responsible for administering, configuring, supporting, and optimizing Atlassian Jira Cloud environments to enable effective collaboration, project tracking, workflow automation, and service management across the enterprise. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and support functions to ensure the Jira platform is secure, scalable, well-governed, and aligned to organizational needs.

This role requires enterprise-level experience supporting complex, global environments, with a strong preference for candidates who have experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Administer and support Jira Cloud, including configuration of projects, workflows, issue types, screens, fields, permissions, schemes, and dashboards.
* Design, implement, and maintain Jira Cloud workflows, automations, and integrations to improve team productivity and process efficiency.
* Support user and group management, access controls, roles, permissions, and platform governance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, performance concerns, and integration failures; coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors as needed.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Jira Cloud solutions.
* Maintain platform standards, documentation, release notes, and configuration inventories.
* Support Atlassian app/add-on evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle management.
* Manage integration with other systems such as Confluence, Slack, MS Teams, CI/CD tools, ITSM platforms, and identity/access management solutions.
* Assist with change management, testing, and deployment of Jira Cloud enhancements.
* Monitor platform usage, data quality, and adoption; recommend improvements to maximize value.
* Ensure compliance with security, audit, and governance requirements.
* Provide end-user support, training, and knowledge transfer as needed.
* Strong experience on AWS or other enterprise cloud environments for platform integrations.
* Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to support reporting, metrics, and operational dashboards.
* Support enterprise-scale platform operations across geographically distributed teams and multiple time zones.

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience administering or engineering Atlassian Jira, with at least some experience in Jira Cloud and Toal experience of 5 -7 years
* Demonstrated enterprise-level experience supporting large, complex, multi-team environments.
* Strong understanding of Jira Cloud configuration, workflows, permissions, schemes, and automation.
* Experience with Jira integrations, APIs, and third-party marketplace apps.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience documenting system changes, processes, and support procedures.
* Experience supporting governance, compliance, and security requirements in an enterprise environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Confluence Cloud administration.
* Experience with Jira Service Management Cloud.
* Familiarity with scripting, REST APIs, or automation tools.
* Experience with identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, or SSO solutions.
* Atlassian certifications.
* Experience supporting regulated environments, including pharmaceutical or life sciences organizations.
* Prior experience in pharma, biotech, or other highly regulated industries.

Skills and Competencies

* Jira Cloud administration
* Workflow design and automation
* Platform governance
* Integration support
* Access and permissions management
* Analytical thinking
* Collaboration and stakeholder management
* Documentation and process improvement
* Enterprise support mindset
* Compliance-aware delivery

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
